method: Exhaustive integer numerator enumeration using published n; ordinary nearest-tenth rounding. Exact ratios also retained.
interpretation: The three baseline accuracies do not map to any integer numerator over the stated 55 test clips at one-decimal rounding. They are compatible with 40, 41, and 43 correct out of 54. This is a consistency flag, not proof that n=54 was actually used. No predictions, missing clip, or corrected significance estimate was invented.
